name: Dungeon Spoils opened below the level of every dungeon item still give the lowest one
contract: Dungeon Spoils (2021814) choose one vanilla dungeon item that fits the opener's level when they are opened. The final boss of Ragefire Chasm gives them to a character below 13, and the lowest items of the pool require 13, so nothing fit and the spoils could not be opened. Opened at level 8 they must be used up and put exactly one item in the bags, taken from the lowest level of the pool: it requires level 13.

steps.label: SETUP: the character holds one Dungeon Spoils
The character opens the spoils at level 8
The opened spoils are used up
The spoils put exactly one of their items in the bags
The item comes from the lowest level of the pool
